summary: Lead your troops and conquer the enemy kingdom in this casual tower war game
description:
Welcome to Tower Battle, the ultimate casual strategy game! 

Draw a line to the enemy base and conquer the tower to win. Guide your soldiers to the victory with simple casual tactics. Connect towers, defend your buildings and takeover the rival kingdom! Select your best units and use special powers to help your troops during the tower war.

Don't let the enemies defeat you! Create your tactics and deploy your troops in the best paths. Conquer towers using tanks, special units and commanders, the strongest allies in the battleground. Create a line through a portal to duplicate the number of troops you send to an enemy base!

Check out this unique features:

- Command your army of quirky characters in this addictive casual tower wargame. 
- Build your defenses, deploy your troops, and conquer enemy towers in epic battles across vibrant landscapes. 
- With intuitive controls and endless tactical possibilities, Tower Battle offers hours of thrilling gameplay for players of all skill levels. 
- Use special troops such as runners, engineers, bombers or mercenaries. Summon unique attacks to reduce enemy's tower attack.
- Think the best strategy to success in this tower game. Choose the correct path and face several enemies at the same time to win.
- Hundreds of symmetrical warfare levels, all of them challenging and full of surprises! Can you conquer all the towers?

Tower Battle is much more than a tower defense strategy game: choose your favorite troops, soldiers and tanks, level them, improve their stats and define the best tactics to win. There are many ways to solve this wargame!

Many levels are waiting for you. It's very easy to play but challenging: connect towers and don't forget to defend your conquered places! Skip obstacles, conquer bases, deploy tanks and change your tactics and strategy following your enemies' moves!

Are you ready to lead your troops to victory? Download now and dominate the battlefield!

This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).
